channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Who you trust to curate books, in this week’s Inside Voices
item.description: “Parents should ultimately be responsible for being involved enough in their children’s lives to know what books they are bringing home from school,” one Utahn says in this week's Inside Voices.

item.title: Westlake boys win the Saratoga Springs school’s first Utah high school championship
item.description: Thunder seniors Graydin Anderson and Brody Thompson each scored 20-plus points to help Westlake win the school's first state title.

item.title: How one Utah bookstore owner is trying to revitalize a Salt Lake City neighborhood
item.description: Annie Pagett, who knows 1974 Bookstore, is paying homage to the Salt Lake City neighborhood that made her family feel welcomed in Utah.

item.title: Latest from Mormon Land: Your choice — Gladys Knight and Mitt Romney speak at conference
item.description: In the latest LDS news, we learn which notable members readers would like to hear speak at General Conference and reveal the prospects of new apostle Clark Gilbert becoming church president someday.

item.title: What to know about the U.S. attacks on Iran
item.description: Here is what you need to know about the attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel and what President Donald Trump is saying about them.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson’s ‘Cosmere’ fantasy universe is coming to Apple TV
item.description: The Utah-based fantasy author has sold more than 50 million books. Soon, his work will hit a popular streaming service.

item.title: Tribune reporter Andy Larsen is changing jobs after years of covering the Utah Jazz
item.description: What might Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen do together on the court? Plus, a look at John Konchar, and a goodbye (sort of) from a Jazz beat writer.

item.title: Suspect arrested in shooting attack on prominent Utah Muslim leader
item.description: The spiritual leader of Utah's largest mosque is "relieved" that police arrested a suspect in the shooting attack that he faced during Ramadan.

item.title: ‘I am truly sorry’: A Utah adoption agency closes suddenly
item.description: A 10-year-old adoption agency has closed down, as Utah legislators appear inclined to approve a bill that would rein in some of the industry's most-criticized practices.

item.title: LDS Church releases statement on U.S., Israeli strikes in Iran
item.description: The church says all members in the Middle East are safe as it monitors U.S. and Israeli strikes in Iran.
